title: List accessible accounts
note: Read account IDs, currencies, and time zones before choosing a target.

title: Read daily campaign metrics
note: Replace the account UUID. Call insights_capabilities first. Inspect complete and next_cursor in the result.

title: Rank purchase ROAS
note: Choose the purchase event and attribution window that match your analysis. The result distinguishes numeric extremes and includes data-through information.

title: Validate a paused campaign
note: This defaults to validation without creating the intended campaign. Check actions_capabilities first. Review the result before a live request; use a new request_id when changing dry_run to false.

title: Save a fact after explicit consent
note: Use this only after the user asks you to save the fact or approves that suggestion. Replace the brand UUID and generate a request UUID. Inspect the returned persistence state.

payload.fact: Use British English for this brand's campaign copy.

title: Find failed tool activity
note: Follow next_cursor with the same filters to read the complete set.

title: Discover saved creatives
note: Inspect the returned version and approval information before selecting content.

title: Poll an accepted launch
note: Use the account and launch IDs from the submission. Inspect launcher_run_operations for individual provider outcomes.
